test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'ABROAD' is written as 'DFORDH' and ‘ACCESS’ is written as ‘DGECVW’. How will 'AGENCY' be written in that language?
solution:
The position of the letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95e8d7f18fcf2b6801af6bc9d1c6a9b0f0dbfacea23a7bd8da0f6df6b5ef99f5.png] 

The code for the given words are shown below:

The code for the word ABROAD is written as DFORDH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4357fd443a835673e8caf6c6699af7275d3d5c1b9a6b5643b53647e547383a7.png] 

Similarly, the word ACCESS is written as DGECVW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13150586e43e88c453f327725bd881a65327238fa9aff4c62a2b2825c109c12.png] 

In the same way, AGENCY will be written as,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61f661c2773344c2148029d70dd080223e0789ad2cdc77a2155ebb116c700b10.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **DKNEFC.**
